title: The integration surface is 'Treasury Register Connector' — first-party, never OIC
context: Early copy referenced Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Product positioning: this is Fusion Practices' own connector into destination systems, not a rebrand of OIC.
decision: Every integration surface — accounting events, GL posting, ERP round-trip — names 'Treasury Register Connector'. Never 'Oracle Integration Cloud' anywhere in code, seed, panel copy, or docs. Supported destinations: Fusion AHCS, Fusion GL, Oracle EBS, Custom REST.
consequences: Reference & Sources panel names it as the destination
Accounting Events panel shows the four supported destinations
Any new integration lands under this brand
audit_notes: There is a project-memory file documenting this: ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/project_connector_first_party.md
